verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents a headless mode meant for control by external clients via its API, UNO acceptor strings for remote connections, and an SDK with API docs and a Developers Guide. Headless conversion has been used hands-on in Docker for PDF generation. Community reports of a painful macro/Python automation experience and missing JavaScript API docs for Calc point to rough developer ergonomics, not a missing API. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the API reference itself (object model coverage, language bindings), and independent corroboration of smooth programmatic control, given the reported poor automation DX.
